endpoint_definition.name: hERG (KCNH2/Kv11.1) inhibition, binary blocker classification
endpoint_definition.definition: label=1 (blocker) if aggregated IC50 <= 10000 nM (10 uM), else label=0 (non-blocker). Threshold is a literature convention (commonly 1-30 uM across published hERG QSAR studies), not a universal biological constant.
endpoint_definition.threshold_source: Phase 3 original choice; re-examined and explicitly retained (not changed) by Phase 3.5 audit Sec 2

filtering_rules: standard_relation == '=' only (censored '>','<','~','>=','<=' excluded per TDS Sec 6.3.1)
data_validity_comment not in ['Potential author error', 'Potential transcription error']
structures standardised via drugsim_chem.process_structure; StructureError -> quarantined
flagged mixtures excluded (no single well-defined structure)
measurements grouped by standardised inchikey_full (merges salt forms of the same entity)
discordant entities (>10x IC50 spread, drugsim_quality.aggregation) excluded from training
note: This dataset was NOT rebuilt for Phase 4. Per Phase 3.5's recommendation, the 10 uM threshold is retained for this registered model; changing it would require a full rebuild and re-validation (leakage, y-scrambling, AD, conformal), which is out of scope for a reliability audit and would constitute retraining, not validating.
